Ultra Power Bank With Dairy | Metal Pen – 10000mAH Smart Corporate Utility

The Ultra Power Bank With Dairy | Metal Pen is a premium multi-utility corporate gifting and promotional solution designed for modern professionals. Combining a high-capacity 10000mAH power bank, a stylish metal pen, and a functional diary organizer, this all-in-one product delivers power, productivity, and presentation in a single elegant package.

Built for business users, executives, and brand promotions, this smart organizer supports IOS, Android, and C-Type devices, making it universally compatible. Whether used in offices, conferences, sales meetings, or as a premium corporate gift, this product reflects innovation, reliability, and brand value.

The integrated ensures uninterrupted connectivity with a robust 10000mAH battery capacity. It features Input DC 5V 2A and Output DC 5V 2A, delivering efficient and stable charging for smartphones and accessories. Ideal for travel, office use, and daily commuting, the keeps devices powered throughout the day.

The includes built-in charging cables compatible with iOS, Android, and Type-C, eliminating the need to carry extra wires. This makes it a perfect choice for professionals who value convenience and organization.

Premium Diary Organizer with Smart Utility Features

Designed as more than just a charger, this product functions as a premium organizer. The flap closure adds a professional look while keeping essentials secure. Inside, you’ll find a dedicated cash and card pocket, allowing users to store business cards, ID cards, or currency safely. The built-in enhances usability, making video calls, presentations, and media viewing hands-free and comfortable. This thoughtful design element adds to the everyday practicality of the product.

Metal Pen with LED Logo for Brand Visibility

A sleek with a secure pen loop is included, ensuring it’s always within reach. The pen features an optional LED logo, making it an excellent branding tool for companies. When illuminated, the logo enhances brand recall and creates a premium impression during meetings or events. The is widely used as a corporate gift, promotional diary, and executive gifting solution due to its functionality and branding potential.

Key Features & Specifications

  • Battery Capacity: 10000mAH
  • Input DC: 5V 2A
  • Output DC: 5V 2A
  • Built-in Cables: IOS, Android & Type-C
  • LED Logo Option for Branding
  • Flap Closure for Secure Storage
  • Cash & Card Pocket
  • Integrated Phone Stand
  • Ideal for Corporate Gifts & Promotions

Perfect for Corporate Gifting & Promotions

This premium organizer is ideal for corporate gifting, employee welcome kits, event giveaways, and brand promotions. Its multifunctional design ensures daily usage, giving your brand continuous visibility.

The aligns with modern business needs by combining technology and stationery in one compact, elegant product. Its durable build, universal charging support, and professional aesthetics make it a high-value choice for companies looking to leave a lasting impression. Choose this premium organizer to elevate your brand presence while offering real utility to your clients, partners, and employees.
